comments.chapter_ranges: Verified against printed contents and embedded scan text; body printed folio equals PDF page minus ten. Interlude begins midway through PDF 145 and remains an in-place subsection of chapter 7 to preserve preceding prose.
comments.copyright: Printed copyright and ISBN reviewed on PDF 2. The scanned copy lists 1996 as its latest reprint; edition date retained as 1993.
comments.margins: Ordinary pages have running heads near y=0.03–0.05 and body lines near y=0.07–0.08. Chapter/part title bands were reviewed separately; no global cutoff is allowed to remove opening body lines.
comments.index: Per-page gutter midpoints checked from the source column envelopes; the initial fixed 0.52 split cut right-column words and was rejected. Corrected index crops must be re-extracted.
comments.primary_ocr: Whole-book Hunspell comparison after dehyphenation: Tesseract 421 unknown types / 779 tokens, Vision 398 / 758, RapidOCR 673 / 1082 (British and Buddhist terminology included). Vision is selected consistently; Tesseract, RapidOCR and the old text layer remain witnesses. Source-checked small-cap openings are clearer in Vision. The index also retains Vision primary: switching to Tesseract introduced wrong 3/5/6 digits and was rejected. Mixed digit/letter references may be recovered only by the shared opt-in two-fresh-engine complete-token-sequence agreement pass.
comments.glossary_and_sayings: Glossary uses ordinary paragraph reconstruction with term-start flags rather than reference-entry hanging layout. Appendix II has a hanging introductory Note and separately aligned aphorisms; hanging layout preserves distinct sayings and wrapped continuations. Synthetic PDF bold fonts are not sufficient to classify glossary definition lines as headings.
comments.annotation: PDF 145 has a handwritten stroke to the left of the printed italic subtitle The Laws of Health. It is not a printed bullet or reference marker. The reviewed annotation is removed by an exact checked source exception; no printed wording is substituted.
comments.protected_vocabulary: Glossary labels and recurring Buddhist terminology are retained alongside attested British spellings; protected terms do not authorize lexical substitutions.

metadata_record_overrides.evidence: Source copyright page PDF 2 explicitly states Element Classics Edition first published 1993 and this copy reprinted 1996. The same-ISBN API date describes an earlier printing.
